description: MainActivity.kt defines the MainActivity class for an Android application. It manages the home screen UI, which includes a top navigation bar and a horizontally scrolling banner carousel fetched from an API endpoint. The activity handles network requests with OkHttp to retrieve banner images in JSON format, displays them in a RecyclerView, and provides error handling and retry logic. It also manages UI states such as loading indicators and error messages, and sets up navigation items with click handling.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: The primary activity class managing the main screen, banner fetching, and navigation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI elements, sets up navigation and RecyclerView, and initiates banner fetching.

methods.name: showError
methods.description: Shows or hides the error container.

methods.name: setBanners
